facts.value: There are limited on-campus options for transfer students; however, it is strongly encouraged to take advantage of off-campus housing options surrounding each ASU campus.
The Off-Campus Housing Marketplace has been developed to help search for apartments or houses in the metro Phoenix area.
Request an official final transcript be sent from your college or university to ASU’s Admission Services as soon as you graduate or complete your current semester or term.
The bus and light rail are affordable options for getting to ASU, and students can walk, bike, or skateboard on campus.
